description: Bug 3: the inconclusive footnote models fault_never_fired as ONE cause but it conflates two genuinely different things the per-ROW note already distinguishes via interferer.failureReason(): (a) the agent never reached the tool the fault targets ('the agent did not complete approve_quote') vs (b) the fault WAS attempted but the merchant refused it ('this merchant's prices cannot be moved'). Split fault_never_fired into two InconclusiveReason values — fault_trigger_not_reached (agent didn't get there) and fault_rejected_by_merchant (attempted, couldn't apply) — plumb the distinction from where the interferer already knows it (interferer.failureReason() is non-null exactly in case (b)), update src/lib/report/inconclusive.ts to name all four causes, and update tests. UI surfaces and SSE routes render the string returned by describeInconclusive(inconclusiveBreakdown(...)) so they propagate automatically; confirm each still compiles and renders.
steps: Read src/lib/runner/run.ts: InconclusiveReason enum (~line 27), the inconclusiveReason computation (~line 481-487), and the note builder (~line 590-610) where interferer.failureReason() already distinguishes case (a) from (b). Read src/lib/runner/interference.ts failureReason() (~line 84): it returns this.failure which is non-null EXACTLY when apply() threw i.e. the fault was attempted but refused (case b); null when the agent never reached the trigger (case a).
In run.ts, replace the single 'fault_never_fired' in the InconclusiveReason union with two: 'fault_trigger_not_reached' and 'fault_rejected_by_merchant'. Keep 'target_withheld' and 'agent_stopped'.

In the inconclusiveReason computation, when perturbationMissed || interferenceMissed, choose fault_rejected_by_merchant when the interferer's failureReason() is non-null (fault attempted, merchant refused), otherwise fault_trigger_not_reached (agent never reached the trigger). NOTE: perturbationMissed uses perturber not interferer — for perturbations there is no failureReason seam, so perturbationMissed maps to fault_trigger_not_reached (the perturbation's applied() count was 0 because the trigger wasn't reached). Only interferenceMissed with a non-null interferer.failureReason() is case (b). Verify the interferer reference is in scope at the computation site; if not, hoist the failureReason() into a local boolean near where interferer is available.

Update src/lib/report/inconclusive.ts: extend InconclusiveBreakdown to carry faultTriggerNotReached and faultRejectedByMerchant (replace faultNeverFired), keep targetWithheld and agentStopped and total. Update inconclusiveBreakdown() counts. Update describeInconclusive() to name all FOUR causes with distinct wording: e.g. (a) 'because the fault it depends on was never triggered — the agent did not reach it', (b) 'because the fault it depends on could not be applied to this merchant'. Update the file's leading doc comment which currently says 'three causes'/'a fourth version' to describe four causes.

Update tests/honest-reporting.test.ts (~line 194-238) which asserts inconclusiveReason 'fault_never_fired' and note 'the fault it depends on was never applied' — split into two tests: one whose fault THROWS (case b, fault_rejected_by_merchant) proven with a scenario whose apply() throws (see interference.test.ts 'cannot be moved' pattern), and one whose trigger is never reached (case a, fault_trigger_not_reached). Assert the two distinct notes and the two distinct inconclusiveReason values. Add coverage for all four causes total.

Prove the tests bite: temporarily collapse the two reasons back into one (or make the branch always pick one), run the new tests, show the case-(a)/case-(b) assertions FAIL; restore the split, show they PASS. Record evidence in findings.

grep for any other reference to the string 'fault_never_fired' across src/ and tests/ and update them (e.g. type guards, switch statements, DB persistence of inconclusiveReason if any). Check src/lib/db and src/lib/dashboard for stored/hydrated inconclusiveReason values.

Run npm run typecheck, npm test; confirm green. Confirm the SSE routes (api/preflight/route.ts, api/merchants/run/route.ts) and pages (page.tsx, MerchantConsole.tsx, PreflightConsole.tsx) still compile since they render the describeInconclusive string.
Run LLM_ADAPTER=scripted PAYMENT_ADAPTER=fake npm run demo:preflight and confirm 8/10/2/5 -> 11/13/1/0, 12/12 both unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: InconclusiveReason has four values: target_withheld, fault_trigger_not_reached, fault_rejected_by_merchant, agent_stopped
describeInconclusive names all four causes with distinct wording; leading doc comment updated to say four
Case (a) trigger-not-reached and case (b) merchant-refused produce distinct inconclusiveReason values and distinct footnote text
New tests fail when the split is collapsed and pass when restored (evidence recorded)
All references to old 'fault_never_fired' string updated across src/ and tests/
typecheck clean, npm test green, demo:preflight numbers unchanged
findings:
Split the single InconclusiveReason 'fault_never_fired' into 'fault_trigger_not_reached' (case a: agent never reached the tool the fault targets, apply() never called, interferer.failureReason() null) and 'fault_rejected_by_merchant' (case b: fault attempted, apply() threw, failureReason() non-null). Kept 'target_withheld' and 'agent_stopped' -> four values total.

CHANGES:
- src/lib/runner/run.ts: updated InconclusiveReason union + its doc comment (three->four causes). Hoisted a local `faultRejectedByMerchant = interferenceMissed && interferer?.failureReason() != null` (interferer is in scope, declared ~line 345). Computation now: targetWithheld -> target_withheld; perturbationMissed||interferenceMissed -> (faultRejectedByMerchant ? fault_rejected_by_merchant : fault_trigger_not_reached); else agent_stopped. perturbationMissed has no failureReason seam so maps to fault_trigger_not_reached as specified.
- src/lib/report/inconclusive.ts: InconclusiveBreakdown now has faultTriggerNotReached + faultRejectedByMerchant (replaced faultNeverFired), keeps targetWithheld/agentStopped/total. inconclusiveBreakdown() counts both new reasons. describeInconclusive() names all four with distinct wording: (a) 'because the fault it depends on was never triggered — the agent did not reach it'; (b) 'because the fault it depends on could not be applied to this merchant'. Leading doc comment rewritten to describe four causes.
- src/lib/scenarios/regression.ts: updated stale comment fault_never_fired -> fault_rejected_by_merchant (this is the throw-on-unperturbable path, which IS case b).
- tests/honest-reporting.test.ts: renamed faultNeverFires helper to faultTriggerNotReached (case a) and added faultRejectedByMerchant helper (case b: full HamperHub purchase reaching approve_quote, apply() throws 'this merchant\'s prices cannot be moved' per interference.test.ts pattern). Split reason test into case-a (fault_trigger_not_reached) and case-b (fault_rejected_by_merchant) tests with distinct footnote assertions; updated footnote-content tests to assert distinct case-a/case-b wording and to cover all four causes ('names every cause a run has').

No DB/dashboard persistence of inconclusiveReason exists (src/lib/db and src/lib/dashboard not present; grep for inconclusive_reason/inconclusiveReason found only run.ts + inconclusive.ts + tests). UI pages and SSE routes render describeInconclusive() output only, so they propagate automatically; typecheck confirms they compile.

REVERT-FAILS/RESTORE-PASSES EVIDENCE: temporarily collapsed the split by forcing `faultRejectedByMerchant = false && ...` in run.ts. Ran tests/honest-reporting.test.ts: 3 FAILED / 15 passed — the case-(b) reason test ('names a fault this merchant refused (case b)' expected fault_rejected_by_merchant, got fault_trigger_not_reached), the case-(b) footnote test ('blames the merchant... case b' missing 'could not be applied to this merchant'), and 'names every cause a run has' all failed. Restored the split: 18/18 passed.

VERIFICATION: npm run typecheck clean (exit 0). npm test = 584 passed / 4 skipped (was 582; +2 net new tests). LLM_ADAPTER=scripted PAYMENT_ADAPTER=fake npm run demo:preflight = vulnerable 8 passed/10 safely-rejected/2 escalated/5 unsafe/0 money-critical -> fixed 11/13/1/0/0, 12/12 policy rules exercised both, 8/8 defects detected, 0 escapes, READY. Unchanged / HamperHub numbers untouched.
